name: Dumbbell Reverse-Grip Bench Press
steps: Lie flat on a bench with feet planted and shoulder blades anchored against the pad.
Hold a dumbbell above each shoulder with an underhand grip, palms angled comfortably toward your head.
Bend your elbows close to your ribs to lower both dumbbells beside your lower chest.
Press the dumbbells smoothly back over your shoulders without twisting your wrists.
tips: Choose a comfortable underhand angle that lets your wrists stay straight and pain-free.
Keep your elbows tucked near your sides and control the weight carefully at the bottom.
